summary: Frontend-only testing for the new 'Biasa with optional variations' feature. Static code review confirms the implementation in produk-form.tsx (renderVarRows in Biasa branch + form-add-variation-biasa button), localdb.ts (persists price_type), and (tabs)/index.tsx (submitBarcode -> familyOptions triggers popup when root.variations.length > 0) matches the spec correctly. However, Playwright/Expo web-preview end-to-end testing could NOT reliably verify the runtime behavior because react-native-web TextInput on the web preview does not synchronize its React state when driven by Playwright's page.fill() or focus()+keyboard.type() (values appear in DOM .value but visual placeholder still shown and no product actually gets persisted). This is a Playwright<->RN-web driver limitation, not necessarily a product bug. Save button click DOES dismiss the form (router.back triggered), but product does not appear in Produk list nor is found by getByBarcode when scanned — strongly indicating the form save was called with empty name (validation returned early) OR react state was not populated. Since the exact same test flow works from a real mobile device (all previous iterations up to iteration_14 for Variasi mode passed), the recommendation is for the main agent to self-verify manually on the web preview and/or Expo Go device. Code review found the feature logic sound (family popup gating uses `root.variations.length > 0`, delete row/toggle price_type/persistence look correct).

integration_issues.flow: Create product via produk-form (BIASA no variations) -> scan B111 in Transaksi
integration_issues.issue: Automated test could not verify. Form closes on Save (router.back triggered) but product is NOT persisted in in-memory DB (subsequent barcode scan returns silently — neither cart line added nor 'Barcode belum terdaftar' toast shown, and product does not appear in Produk list). Likely root cause is Playwright's fill/type not triggering react-native-web TextInput onChangeText correctly for this build; needs manual verification.

integration_issues.flow: Create product BIASA with 3 variations (form-add-variation-biasa) -> scan B222 popup
integration_issues.issue: Same input-syncing limitation. Screenshot evidence during script shows only 1 variation row appears reliably after 3 clicks of form-add-variation-biasa (rows 1 and 2 may not be added, or focus lost during Ctrl+A). Recommend main agent verify on device.

integration_issues.flow: Re-open persistence + delete row + Grosir/Variasi mode toggle
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute because Soklin was never persisted in the automated run. Static review shows priceType initial state correctly reads editing.price_type, and Grosir/Variasi mode branches remain untouched.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking, but worth migrating. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (styles.addBtnPrimary shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset), and produk-form.tsx footer style.

Console: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — coming from bottom-sheet/gesture-handler on web. Native only; safe to ignore on web preview, but if any custom animation uses useNativeDriver:true on web, wrap with Platform.OS !== 'web' guard.

action_items: Main agent: Please manually verify the 3 flows on Expo web preview or Expo Go: (1) Create GulaBiasa (Biasa, barcode B111, no variations, Harga Jual 3000) -> scan B111 in Transaksi -> should add directly at Rp3.000 with no popup; (2) Create Soklin (Biasa, barcode B222, Harga Beli 2000, Harga Jual utama 3000) with 3 variation rows via form-add-variation-biasa (1 pcs=1000, 1 renteng=5000, 2 renteng=9000) -> scan B222 -> should open 'Pilih Variasi Soklin' popup listing 3 variations; (3) Re-open Soklin from Produk list -> form must open in Biasa mode (form-pricetype-biasa active, form-add-variation-biasa visible, form-add-barcode NOT visible) with 3 variation rows populated and main Harga Jual = 3000.

Optionally: If automated regression via Playwright is needed, consider adding a testable data-* attribute on the root <Text> price/name of the product row list AND expose a small test-only helper (window.__debug.createProduct) so an integration test can bypass the flaky TextInput input event issue on RN-web.
Consider migrating deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents inline props to their StyleSheet-native counterparts (boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents) to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: produk-form.tsx: The Biasa branch correctly uses renderVarRows() which reuses the SAME variations state array as the Variasi branch. On save() the payload writes variations for both 'biasa' and 'variasi' price_type (line 82-91), and price_type field is persisted (line 92) — this correctly enables the family popup on scan when a Biasa product has variations.

(tabs)/index.tsx submitBarcode: Popup gate `children.length > 0 || (root.variations && root.variations.length > 0)` correctly opens the popup for a Biasa product that has entries in root.variations. Good.

localdb.ts createProduct: `price_type: data.price_type ?? undefined` — undefined is stored; then form uses `editing.price_type ?? (fallback logic)` which correctly falls back to variasi/grosir/biasa based on data. Works.

produk-form.tsx line 236: The main Harga Jual label switches to 'Harga Induk' only when priceType === 'variasi' AND hasVar. For Biasa (even with variations) the label remains 'Harga Jual' — matches the spec requirement.
produk-form.tsx line 65: validation blocks empty variation names in both biasa AND variasi mode — good.
Minor: form-variation-remove-N in Biasa mode reuses the same testID prefix as the Variasi mode's inline rows. Should be fine because only one branch renders at a time.
produk-form.tsx: `let vid = 0;` module-level counter — resets only on hot reload; fine for a form modal but a `useRef(0)` would be cleaner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Automated Playwright testing of react-native-web TextInput in this repo is unreliable — page.fill() sets DOM .value but visually shows placeholder, and Save behaves as if the field is empty. Both page.fill() and click()+keyboard.press('Control+A')+Delete+keyboard.type() were tried. Consider: (a) using page.evaluate to dispatch a native InputEvent with bubbles:true and setter override; or (b) mounting the app with a test-only global helper exposing api.createProduct so tests can seed products directly. All new testIDs (form-add-variation-biasa, form-var-name-N, form-var-sell-N, form-variation-remove-N, form-pricetype-biasa/grosir/variasi) are present and locatable in the DOM.
rca_of_issue: Testing environment RCA: react-native-web renders TextInput as a plain <input>/<textarea>; however the onChangeText handler is wired through a synthetic-event pipeline that expects a proper native input event with the value already on the target and appropriate bubbling. Playwright's fill() should trigger this, but in this Expo build the state does not update — likely because a controlled/uncontrolled mix (Field uses value={value} onChangeText={onChange} while TextInput uses defaultValue elsewhere) or because RN-web 0.19+ tracks its own last-value cache to dedupe events. Repro: open produk-form, run in DevTools console: `const i=document.querySelector('[data-testid=form-name]'); i.focus(); i.value='X'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))` — observe whether the React state (visible by placeholder disappearing) updates. Mitigation options: (1) use `nativeInputValueSetter` trick with dispatchEvent for tests; (2) add test-only imperative API (window.__test = {createProduct: api.createProduct}); (3) rely on real device / Expo Go for full E2E.
